svg.aria-label: Oxygen molecules moving from outside through the phospholipid bilayer into the cytoplasm and carbon dioxide moving out, down their concentration gradients
svg.text: Simple diffusion across the phospholipid bilayer
outside the cell: high O₂ concentration
cytoplasm: O₂ used in respiration, low concentration
Small, non-polar molecules pass between phospholipids, down their concentration gradient. Not selective; no energy used.
